openings.claim: Use confusion counting to expose whether disputed labels can change the further-evaluation decision; this is a review probe, not deployment evidence.
openings.delta: Change the count-cell dependency from provisional labels alone to paired baseline/candidate outcomes grouped by slice, with conservative contribution ranges for unresolved flagged labels. The carrier remains a spreadsheet or local script. The nearest ordinary rival is separate baseline and candidate confusion tables using the currently available labels.
openings.prediction: When unresolved flagged rows can move the overall gain across four or a slice loss across two, the range table will explicitly return unresolved even if provisional point counts pass. If every compatible bound passes, it can support advance; if all compatible possibilities fail acceptance, reject. This advantage disappears when adjudication resolves every decision-relevant disagreement or the rival already computes equivalent bounds.
openings.probe: Run both variants on matched copies within seventy minutes. Use the same predeclared flagged-record identifier order, attempting withheld rows and adjudicating at most sixteen accessible rows per copy. Preserve each used identifier and label, access failures, allowance use and elapsed time in the supplied probe records. Freeze both reports before opening the full-label key. Compare decision support, affected slices and accounting against that key. Evaluate whether bounds expose uncertainty that point counts conceal; no guaranteed decision or measured benefit is asserted.
assumptions: Predictions and slice identifiers remain fixed; only selected sealed labels replace provisional labels.

For an unresolved row with differing predictions, candidate-minus-baseline correctness lies between minus one and plus one; matching predictions contribute zero. These are conservative bounds, not invented labels.
Joint compatibility must be preserved when testing whether all possible outcomes fail; loose separate bounds may require unresolved.
Four withheld rows can defeat certification. Sixteen adjudications and seventy minutes may also leave unresolved; implementation feasibility is unmeasured.

assessment: One opening uses the first parent function alone. Conservative bounds preserve thresholds and the unresolved option; the supplied provisional observations do not establish the final decision.
